// diagnostic

E2805

Invalid HTTP route `{pattern}`: {reason}.

What

Invalid HTTP route `{pattern}`: {reason}.

Why

Route patterns and typed inputs define one checked endpoint contract. Paths bind by handler name, and their types must support Decode.

Fix

Use `:name` or final `*name` with a matching decodable handler parameter; fix the path or handler signature before registration.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2805: tests/ui/http_route_constant_path.stderr.

Error [jet.InvalidRoute]: HTTPRouter route path must be a static String or Path
  --> http_route_constant_path.jet:13:16
    |
 13 |     router.get(path, handle)
    |                ^^^^
 Why: Router endpoint contracts are fully checked while building; mux value routes may be computed at runtime
 Fix: Use a literal, a compile-time String constant or a Path without holes, or register the dynamic route on a mux
